crossRefs.note: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit…
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children…
Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

translations.web: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
translations.bsb: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
translations.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
translations.asv: and might deliver all them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
